rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is difficult to understand or interpret.

example.english: The wording of this contract is inscrutable, even after I have read it several times.
example.traditional: 呢份合約啲條文太難明，我睇咗幾次都係唔明。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 hap6 joek3 di1 tiu4 man4 taai3 naan4 ming4 ngo5 tai2 zo2 gei2 ci3 dou1 hai6 m4 ming4

rows.note: Use this when you cannot see through a person's motives or fully figure out a situation.

example.english: I find it inscrutable why they have suddenly started treating me so well.
example.traditional: 我真係睇唔透佢點解突然對我咁好。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 tai2 m4 tau3 keoi5 dim2 gaai2 dat6 jin4 deoi3 ngo5 gam3 hou2

rows.note: Use this when something is baffling or makes no sense, often with a hint that it is odd or unreasonable.

example.english: Their suddenly yelling at me was completely inscrutable.
example.traditional: 佢無啦啦鬧我，真係莫名其妙。
example.jyutping: keoi5 mou4 laa1 laa1 naau6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 mok6 ming4 kei4 miu6
